fomod.Name: MMO Hotbar
fomod.Author: MMOHotbar (fork of STB Hotkey System by STB)
fomod.Description: MMO-style 12-slot hotbar over a chord-based favorites hotkey core (full fork of STB Hotkey System, GPL-3.0-only). The bar shows one row of 12 slots at a time, and each preset is an independent 12-slot table of your own keys -- tap X to flip between preset 1 and 2. Bind from inventory/magic/favorites, stack groups, keycaps on rows. One SKSE DLL only.
